build_int32_bsearch: build a batched binary search over int32 values using a monotonic predicate function
build_float32_bsearch: build a binary search over finite float32 numbers using a monotonic predicate
build_topk_mask: build a top-k masking function that keeps the largest k values per batch element and replaces the rest
build_topp_mask: build a top-p masking function that keeps the smallest set of logits whose probability mass meets a threshold
run_binary_search: run binary search over int32 or float32 bit patterns with a custom monotonic predicate
